g.aria-label: Why Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Shines on Unified-Memory Systems
Needs 59 GiB RAM to hold all 128 experts
Routes each token to only 4 of 128 experts!
MoE Decouples Capacity from Decode Bandwidth: Total parameters set the RAM required to fit,
while active parameters per token set the bytes streamed per decode step!
